summary_1line: After Indra causes a mix-up of garments, Sarmishtha insults and throws Devayani into a well, where King Yayati later rescues her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sarmishtha angrily pushes Devayani into a deep forest well after their heated quarrel beside the lake.
King Yayati peers into a dry well and sees the radiant Devayani standing below among creeping vines.
The maidens rise from the lake to find their garments mysteriously mixed together on the bank.
